scope: Construction of one explicitly selected screened riverbank water-intake facility WI-RIVERBANK-RC-2B-8000-4P with design capacity 8000 m3/day, two reinforced-concrete intake bays, four SS316 coarse-screen panels and four vertical-turbine raw-water pumps VTP-250LPS-32M. Direct civil structures, intake components, pumps, valves, internal piping, electrical-control interfaces, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved raw-water intake design, hydraulic and structural calculations, equipment and embedded-part schedules, geotechnical and hydrological reports, temporary-river-works design, manufacturers, commissioning program and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: external village distribution network, borehole, water-treatment plant, clean-water reservoir, water tower or sewer scope
civil, screen, pump, valve, piping, electrical, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from capacity, bay count or pump count
automatic cofferdam, river diversion, construction dewatering or fish-protection system
universal retained spare or supplier-package quantity
